plainText:
Rika (Japanese: チリ Chili) is a member of the Elite Four of the Paldea region. She specializes in .

==In animation==
===History===
Rika first appeared in Welcome to Naranja Academy!. Rika first appeared when she was introduced by Nemona to Liko, Roy, and Dot. During the brief meeting, Rika commented that she expected great things from Liko as Indigo Academy's representative. Later, she watched Liko's battle against Ann and noticed great potential in her.

In Showdown! The Paldea Elite Four, Rika was battling students of Naranja Academy as part of the Elite Four Tag Battle. Using her and , she was able to defeat Tulip and Sidian by defeating the latter's before proceeding to battle Liko and Katy. In the next episode, she battled against Liko and Katy, winning by Terastalllizing her Clodsire to defeat Liko's Floragato.

In Shine on, Terastallization! Liko vs. Roy!, Rika and Geeta met up with Liko to discuss the results of her training, she then watched Liko's battle against Roy. After the battle, Rika and Geeta congratulated Liko on her growth as a Trainer, and along with Geeta, suggested that Liko consider battling in the in the future.

In Over the Top!, Rika welcomed the Rising Volt Tacklers along with Penny, the other members of Paldea's Elite Four, and Geeta, after which Rika watched Liko, Roy, and Dot battle Geeta.

===Character===
Rika showed a deep interest in seeking especially strong s that can hold their own in the Paldea League. During the meeting with Liko, she cited the high level that Trainers from the Kanto region tend to be at and later when she saw Liko in battle, realizing the enormous potential Liko has as a Trainer. She is generally lighthearted and kind to others, taking the time before a battle to reassure Liko and calm her down, and even joking around with her to try and break the ice. However, she is incredibly ruthless in battle and does not hold back, encouraging others to do the same.

As a member of the Paldea Elite Four, Rika is an incredibly skilled and powerful trainer in and of herself, being able to properly and expertly command both her Pokémon at once and improvising strategies and move combinations on the spot. She also does not hesitate to stallize her Pokémon upon seeing her opponent pull out all the stops, despite having the Tera Type disadvantage.
